The '''Imperial Aquatic Garrison''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[IM-A-761 Oceanic Garrison]] 200 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] southeast of [[Fitsay]], on the [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]].

==Characteristics==
The Imperial Aquatic Garrison was an [[IM-A-761 Oceanic Garrison]],<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> with a layout almost exactly like a ground-based [[IM-455 modular garrison]], except that the lower level was under water instead of being underground. The garrison base was surrounded by a nearly invisible underwater [[Death fence|energy fence]]; [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] and [[Proximity mine/Legends|proximity mines]] were also deployed inside the fence.<ref name="BGS" />

A [[flotation collar]] around the base kept the garrison atop the waves, however the garrison was anchored to the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] floor by [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projectors]] to prevent drift and stabilize the entire structure. The doors opened to the ocean to launch ships from vehicle bay, but underwater launch ports were also available.<ref name="BGS" />

==History==
The structure itself was the typical water-world base, but the [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] garrison was under construction. It was also understaffed, getting to Sedri was hazardous until the [[Golden Sun]] was destroyed, thus the base had less than 250 people instead of 3000. Among other personnel and vehicles, the Sedri garrison had 50 [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], 30 [[Aquatic assault stormtrooper|seatroopers]], 15 [[Waveskimmer/Legends|waveskimmers]], 3 [[wavespeeder]]s, 1 [[Aquatic Terrain Armored Transport|AT-AT Swimmer]], 10 [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Fighters]] and 2 [[TIE fighter boat]]s.<ref name="BGS" />

The Empire lost interest in the planet months after the vanishing of the Golden Sun, abandoning the garrison. Due to the lack of maintenance, the garrison was expected to sink within a year.<ref name="SOTSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The backcover of [[Battle for the Golden Sun]] names it Imperial Sea Garrison, but it is called Imperial Aquatic Garrison elsewhere.
